name: The Black Shield
summary: In Brackenwall Village, Do'gol sends you to Krog to learn a name on the shield. The writing seems to say Mosarn, but Do'gol does not know the name.

sections.title: A Name on the Rim
sections.body: Do'gol has rubbed the shield with too much acid, yet its writing remains hard to read. The name seems to be Mosarn, but Do'gol does not know it. Krog knows many people in Brackenwall Village, so Do'gol sends you to speak with Krog.

sections.title: Krog's Answer
sections.body: Krog recognizes the name Mosarn, though cannot place it. Krog hopes it will come back to mind. Still, Krog says the name may not matter. Shields come from all sorts of places and carry no meaning.

faq.answer: Do'gol is cleaning the shield with acid so its writing can be read.

faq.q: What name is on the shield?
aliases: what name is on the shield
faq.answer: The writing is hard to read, but Do'gol thinks it says Mosarn. The name is unfamiliar to Do'gol.

faq.q: Why talk to Krog about the shield?
faq.answer: Do'gol does not know who Mosarn is, but says Krog knows many people.

attribution: Classic quest text: The Black Shield
